raw_output_policy: Original generated images retained in Codex generated_images; complete copies and manually written prompts in this production source folder.
reference_ownership: Project-approved source images supplied/generated in this project; no third-party game sprites or commercial art packs.
editable_policy: OpenRaster contains independent whole-asset raster layers. Original image generation has no brushstroke PSD history; raw atlases, original prompts, crops metadata and full resolution PNGs preserved.
license_notes: Use under applicable image generation service terms. No claim of exclusive copyright or third-party asset license implied. Existing Cormorant Garamond font and OFL retained at art/ui/fonts/OFL.txt. Procedural runtime geometry is limited to precise UI/VFX and native contact shadows, not substitute character/map paintings.
lfs: Largest new source measured under 7 MB; no PSD/video/raw-audio heavy storage introduced; no repository-wide LFS or gitignore rules changed.
